_README: PROPOSED, INACTIVE (every map has enabled:false). NOT read by demiurge-io from here. Merge the `maps` array into ~/demiurge/sensors.json only if the pool route is chosen INSTEAD of cardinal-ctl's analog mirror (set CARDINAL_MIRROR_ANALOG=0). Sink writes ch9 to Midi Through (14:0), so Cardinal's MIDI modules must be set to channel 9 and Midi-Bridge:'Midi Through Port-0 (capture)' linked to Cardinal:events-in. Activation: demiurge-io hot-reloads sensors.json by mtime, but whether a NEW mapped source CC joins the --midi-mapped-only subscription without a restart is UNVERIFIED; if not, activation = restart demiurge-io (expression pedal dead ~2 s) which needs Emory's go. ch1 CC29 is never mapped (DUODECIMUS pedal; the midi sink also blocks it). Encoder accumulation, the 8 slot buttons, arcade gating and tap tempo are NOT here: the pool has no relative-encoder accumulation or slot switching, and its midi sink blocks ch16 104-119 (tap CC112/113). Pool maps have no per-source smoothing configured here; add `sources` entries (smooth_ms, deadzone, in_lo/in_hi) to match slots.json shaping if this route is chosen.
